collation_policy.reference: CLDR 47 standard national tailoring, restricted to characters representable in the selected DOS page.
collation_policy.dos_limit: One weight per input byte cannot implement Unicode multi-level whole-string collation, expansions or normalization. Define and test a deterministic case-insensitive single-byte ordering explicitly.
limits: This defines a DOS single-byte adaptation, not full Unicode multi-level whole-string collation. In particular Lithuanian secondary distinctions become per-character group distinctions.
No contractions, expansions, Unicode normalization, or language-sensitive multi-character uppercase conversion.
Legacy 437/850 modes preserve their own byte encoding and therefore cannot represent all national letters. CP775 is the complete Baltic text profile.
collation_policy.ordering: For collation only, identify a letter by its single-character Unicode uppercase, even when that uppercase is absent from the page; sharp s and micro sign identify themselves. Non-letter bytes sort first in unsigned byte order. Representable letter groups then follow the explicit collation_groups sequence with one increasing weight per group. A group omitted by a page consumes no weight. Case partners share their group weight. This does not change the separately specified DOS uppercase conversion.
collation_policy.foreign_letters: Additional Latin letters in legacy pages are explicitly placed near their base. Ordinals, superscript n and the CP437 Greek letters have explicit trailing groups. Sharp s and micro sign each have their own group; no multi-character conversion is performed.

case_policy: ASCII a-z map to A-Z. For an extended byte, use its Unicode uppercase only when it is exactly one character and encodable in the same page; otherwise retain the byte. Use the same table for filename uppercase.

filename_policy.basis: Existing single-byte DOS filename and wildcard contracts; reuse the existing us_flist record.
filename_policy.short_names: 8.3 byte fields; all national CP775 letters remain legal.
filename_policy.wildcards: Question mark matches one padded field position; star fills the remainder of that field.
